articles.title: New Armored Dinosaur Discovered in Japan — And It May Have Walked from Alaska
articles.summary: A new species of armored dinosaur has been identified from fossils found in Japan. Scientists think its ancestors migrated from North America across an ancient land bridge. Only three nodosaurids have ever been found in Asia.

articles.title: Interstellar Comet 3I/ATLAS Carries the Building Blocks of Life
articles.summary: A comet from another star system, 3I/ATLAS, contains organic molecules that are key ingredients for life. It's only the third interstellar object ever found, and scientists say it shows life's building blocks are common in our galaxy.

articles.title: Jupiter: The Failed Star with a 300-Year-Old Hurricane
articles.summary: Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system — a gas giant so big it could hold 1,300 Earths. It has nearly 70 moons, a centuries-old storm, and a moon that might hide an ocean with life.
